jobs.title: DevOps Engineer - Work from home
jobs.description: Join Nortal for your next big adventure. We are seeking a DevOps Engineer to join our team, grow with us, and teach us a few things along the way. Why join Nortal Say Goodbye to Micromanagement: We champion autonomy, open communication, and respect for diversity as our core values. Outcomes Over Hours: We believe in a work model focused on impact, providing you with the flexibility to balance your professional success with your personal well-being. Vibrant Community: Join our close-knit LATAM remote team and connect through tech talks, virtual coffee breaks, and team-building activities. Support from Day One: Our People Care team is here to support you throughout your journey, from wellness check-ins to professional growth. Our Benefits ✨ Competitive USD salary. 100% remote work: While you can work from anywhere, you’re always welcome to connect with teammates and grow your network at our coworking spaces across LATAM. Paid time off & national holidays: Take the time you need according to your country’s regulations while receiving your full salary. Sick leave: Focus on your health without stress. Take the necessary time to recover and feel better. Annual credit: Spend it on the perks you love to enhance your work-life balance. Team-building activities: Join us for coffee breaks, tech talks, and after-work gatherings to bond with your Nortal family and feel part of our vibrant community. Birthday off: Enjoy an extra day off during your birthday week to celebrate in style with friends and family. About the project: As a Senior DevOps Engineer , you will help operate and scale the cloud platform behind IKEA Kreativ, supporting millions of users globally and powering advanced 3D, AI, and Visualization experiences. You will work closely with engineering and product teams to build reliable, scalable infrastructure across multiple cloud platforms while helping drive technical excellence and operational efficiency. What you’ll do: Be a hands-on DevOps engineer, guiding design & development of the platform’s cloud architectures and systems integrations – in collaboration with the engineering team. Improve features, scalability and reliability of the platform by leading technical & process improvements. Reliably coordinate complex technology roadmaps and be a close trusted partner to the product and development teams. Work closely with internal service teams to design, build and develop systems that scale to millions of customers around the world and run on multiple cloud platforms. Design and promote healthy & effective engineering practices in the team – conduct code reviews to ensure code & architecture quality, write and review software design documents, and drive efficient and effective test automation. What makes you a great fit: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 5+ Years of experience with Kubernetes and Linux container tools. 4+ Years of experience with CI/CD/Gitops workflows and tooling. 3+ Years of experience

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer I
jobs.description: At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology. Cadence Design Systems Inc. is looking for a motivated Cybersecurity Engineer I to work with us in Belo Horizonte, Brazil. This person would join our Information Security team maintaining and enhancing our log management infrastructure, ensuring reliable, secure, and scalable ingestion of security-relevant data across the enterprise. The ideal candidate will possess knowledge in log collection technologies, SIEM administration, and SOAR integrations, with a strong focus on automation, performance optimization, and compliance. Job Description Administer and maintain log servers including upgrades, patching, and migrations. Design and implement high availability and clustering solutions for log servers. Manage log archiving, retention policies, and backup strategies. Onboard new log sources from cloud platforms, applications, network devices, and endpoints. Perform log parsing, normalization, and selective event ingestion to optimize SIEM performance. Configure streaming and forwarding mechanisms for real-time log delivery. Develop scripts (e.g., Python, Shell) for log processing, automation, and system tasks. Utilize APIs for log collection, integration, and automation workflows. Create dashboards, reports, and configure alerts for log ingestion health and security insights. Monitor data quality and ingestion anomalies, ensuring completeness and accuracy. Work closely with SOC, IR, and infrastructure teams to align log management with security operations. Document log source configurations, ingestion pipelines, and architectural decisions. Requirements Complete Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience) Experience/contact with Cybersecurity: Hands-on experience with Syslog technologies (NXLOG, syslog-ng, Snare, rsyslog). Contact with log management, SIEM engineering, or security data operations. Strong Linux administration and scripting skills. Proven experience with cloud log ingestion (AWS, Azure, GCP). Familiarity with APIs and log streaming technologies. Nice To Have Certifications such as Splunk Certified Architect, Elastic Certified Engineer, CISSP, GIAC. Experience with SOAR platforms and playbook development. Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) and their logging mechanisms. Additional Job Details Employment category: CLT Employment term: 40 hours/week. Competitive benefits. Location: Av Contorno 5800, Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais Brazil. About Cadence Design Systems Cadence is the only company that provides the expertise and tools, IP, and hardware required for the entire electronics design chain, from chip design to chip packaging to boards and to systems. We enable electronic systems and semiconductor companies to create innovative products that transform the way people live, work, and play. Our products are used in mobile, consumer, cloud datacenter, automotive
